resources.string: Turn on the Picture shortcut to open Image Settings with Menu on your remote, even while a video plays.\n\nIn Android TV Settings, go to Device Preferences → Accessibility → Services. Choose Projector Guy Picture shortcut and turn it on. Select Allow if asked.
While the shortcut is on, Menu opens Image Settings in place of the menu in the app you’re using.
Press Menu from Home or while watching a video. Use the arrows and OK to adjust the picture. Press Back to close Image Settings.
To restore the usual Menu button, turn off Projector Guy Picture shortcut in Android TV Settings.
